Actionable findings
R049-N1 | Major | C2 | high confidence
words\科学.md:5,9 lacks direct guards against 地理, 数学, 歴史 and 経済. Unqualified "наука" is a defensible broad answer for each actual disciplinary sense, not merely a neighboring school subject. RU field senses: 地理:15-18, 数学:15-17, 歴史:15-16, 経済:15-16; complete official entries 1421540, 1372980, 1558050, 1251320. Returned Russian Wiktionary definitions independently identify geography:1, mathematics I:1, history:2-3 and economics:2 as sciences. Finer lesson distinctions do not remove caption ambiguity.
Minimal fix: four direct 科学 exclusions [地理, 数学, 歴史, 経済], documenting each field sense. No school-subject clique or false natural-science-only restriction.

R049-N2 | Major | C2 | high confidence
words\歴史.md:4-9 versus words\話.md:4,9,16-22: new "история" also means narrated story, a valid answer for 話. The existing RU example actually says "Я рассказал ребёнку короткую историю". Complete official 1600900:5 is tale/story/fable under はなし, not the わ counter; Russian история:6 confirms narrative. This does not claim Japanese 歴史 means invented stories.
Minimal fix: direct 歴史-話 protection on new 歴史; retain teaching distinctions and baseline metadata.

R049-N3 | Major | C2 | high confidence
words\経済.md:4-9,26-27 versus words\お金.md:4,15: bare "финансы" has a colloquial money/cash sense, correctly labeling お金. Complete official 1001820 identifies おかね as money; 1251320:2 licenses 経済's finances sense. Returned Russian финансы:2 explicitly means деньги/наличность. Economic-system-versus-money distinctions do not disambiguate this option.
Minimal fix: direct 経済-お金 protection on new 経済. No claim that all economic activity equals cash.

All nine support qualified direct conservative protection, NOT ordinary modern necessity/frequency or N4 endorsement of rare senses:
Q1 科学-勉強: actual наука colloquial lesson sense 3 meets 1512670:3 future lesson/experience; not studying=research.
Q2 科学-教育: наука's colloquial obsolete обучение sense 4 meets 1236950:1 instruction; no modern synonymy.
Q3 科学-授業: independently 1330290:1 teaching/instruction meets that same old Russian sense; not transitive through Q2.
Q4 科学-教室: old instruction/training can contextually cover 1237150:3 course/lessons, NOT room; weaker/context-qualified, not an ordinary classroom synonym.
Q5 文化-教育: культура development/cultivation sense 2 fits independently 1236950:2 culture/cultivation; not employee training or shared group membership.
Q6 産業-工業: actual промышленность fits narrower manufacturing industry, 1278040:1; broad/narrow bodies remain distinct.
Q7 産業-仕事: 1303770:2 expressly ARCHAIC occupation fits работа/1304970:1; not ordinary industry=any task.
Q8 技術-手: actual техника fits 1327190:6 technique/workmanship; no body-part clique.
Q9 技術-上手: actual умение fits independent 1580400:4 dexterity, restricted to うわて; not ordinary じょうず=technology or かみて stage/river readings.
